x: Every year the Belgrave Championship Meeting produces either its record or its “sensation.” This year no Club record was broken, but I think there was the usual “sensation.” A tall schoolboy from Buckingham Gate School won the 100 yards championship for boys under 15, from G.
100 Yards Junior Handicap (under 16).—1, F. Skelly (scr.); 2, G.
Jones and G. Crilly, who were second and third, are also to be placed in the highly promising class, both being lads who are certain to improve if they stick to regular training methods.
Carter just beat G. Crilly for third place, and on the form shown, we have several very promising young runners.
